nodes.label: System Architecture
nodes.rationale: High-level overview of single Next.js app serving platform super-admin, hotel staff dashboard, and guestbooking via middleware routing, backed by Supabase and Clerk.

nodes.label: Multi-Tenancy Architecture
nodes.rationale: Shared database with row-level security (RLS) isolation based on Clerk Organizations, JWT custom claims, and storage paths.

nodes.label: Payment System (Paystack)
nodes.rationale: Multi-tenant payment routing via Paystack subaccounts scoped by paystack_subaccount_code.

nodes.label: User Onboarding Flow
nodes.rationale: Split onboarding into two buckets: Hotel Admin creates the Clerk org and saves profile; Staff are invited and bypass onboarding.

nodes.label: Booking Page Development Access
nodes.rationale: Developers can access booking page via query param, subdomain (localhost mapping), or environment variable.

nodes.label: Database Schema Conventions
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL schema rules including UUID PKs, created_at/updated_at timestamps, decimal money (NUMERIC(10,2)), and soft deletes.

nodes.label: HMS Brand Logo Icon
nodes.rationale: Minimalist brand identity using a bold serif 'H' typography inside a dark stone-900 (#1C1917) rounded container, emphasizing simplicity, luxury, and professional design taste.
